payload.title: cart badge count updates after adding an item
payload.errorMessage:
expect(locator).toHaveText(expected) failed

Locator: getByTestId('cart-count-badge')
Expected: "3"
Received: "2"

note: A badge showing one less than expected reads like an off-by-one cart bug — this run failed once, with no retry-then-passed to rely on. But the UI optimistically increments the badge locally then reconciles against the server's cart-total response; the assertion sometimes fires between the optimistic paint and the reconcile. A meaningfully high but still intermittent 17.5% historical rate confined to this one assertion (not the whole cart flow) is the wrong shape for a broken increment, which would fail on every add-to-cart once the code path is hit — it points to a UI-only race instead.
